statement: The knowledge tier ingested the whole Simple English Wikipedia dump (284749 articles) at 3950.7 articles/s with a bz2 reader written for it, holding 284454 articles (breadth 0.9990) as 1911943 facts at 1365 disk and 407 memory bytes per article. Of the organism's memory kinds asked to hold the same title keys, knowledge held at this scale; semantic and assoc stop at their 4096 capacity and episodic at 65536. The bar is met.
